lines: Concepcion played 85% of snaps over the last three games, up from 74% on the season. His target share dipped to 17% from 20%.
He's scoring more lately, averaging 12.4 PPR points over the last three games against 10.0 for the season. His usage-based expected points came in lower, at 9.1.
Cleveland has a bye in Week 11. Coach Todd Monken said the offense will keep looking for ways to get Concepcion the ball.
